title: Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Ian J. Goodfellow, Jean Pouget-Abadie, Mehdi Mirza, Bing Xu, David Warde-Farley, Sherjil Ozair, Aaron Courville, and Yoshua Bengio submitted Generative Adversarial Networks on June 10, 2014. The paper proposed a framework for estimating generative models by simultaneously training a generative model and a discriminative model in a minimax two-player game.
significance: A documented research milestone introducing the adversarial generative-modeling framework in which a generator and discriminator are trained against one another.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes June 10, 2014 as the first submission date and directly supports the authorship and two-model adversarial/minimax formulation. The official NeurIPS 2014 proceedings independently corroborate the paper, authors and technical framework. The date is attached specifically to the paper-submission milestone. The record does not assert a product or software release, deployment, institutional geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, or relationships.
